steak-cast-iron-beginner.name: Classic Cast Iron Steak
ingredients: 1 ribeye or NY strip steak (1.5 inches thick)
instructions: Pat steak bone dry—I mean DRY, apprentice
Season generously with salt and pepper
Let sit 30 minutes at room temp (patience)
Heat cast iron until smoking hot (500°F+)
Don't touch it for 3 minutes (trust the process)
Flip once, add butter and aromatics
Rest 10 minutes before cutting (this is critical)
steak-cast-iron-beginner.jake_story: First steak I ever cooked in cast iron, I moved it around like I was nervous. Ended up with no crust and a sad, gray steak. The iron needs TIME to work its magic. Same as life—sometimes you gotta let things sit and trust they'll turn out right.
tips: Dry meat = good sear (water is the enemy)
